cwd.description: Absolute working directory used to resolve the new conversation's configuration.

modelProvider.description: Provider override, as in `thread/start`; omission uses the server default.

newThread.description: Read a fresh root conversation's account instead of the global login. Cannot be combined with `threadId`.

refreshToken.description:
When `true`, requests a proactive token refresh before returning.

In managed auth mode this triggers the normal refresh-token flow. In external auth mode this flag is ignored. Clients should refresh tokens themselves and call `account/login/start` with `chatgptAuthTokens`.

threadId.description: Read the conversation's account instead of the global login.
